purpose: Define AccessCore policy objects as explicit stable canonical identities with scope, resource targets and rule ownership separate from UI configuration and runtime decision state.

topics.name: AccessCore Policy Identity
topics.purpose: Define AccessCore policy objects as explicit stable canonical identities with scope, resource targets and rule ownership separate from UI configuration and runtime decision state.

semantics.identity_rule: Every machine-significant AccessCore policy has an explicit stable identity.
semantics.scope_rule: Policy scope identifies the governed instance/resource namespace or explicit target set.
semantics.owner_rule: Policy ownership is explicit and separate from the identities governed by the policy.
semantics.ui_rule: Editor nesting or page location does not define policy identity/scope.
semantics.state_rule: Policy definition is declarative; evaluation decisions are runtime results.
semantics.version_rule: Machine-significant policy change creates explicit version/change evidence according to canonical change rules.

invariants.rule: AccessCore decisions are explicit policy evaluations over identity, resource and operation context; authentication assurance, visibility and ownership never silently become authorization.

hard_gates.condition: policy identity inferred only from file/UI path
policy definition conflated with runtime allow/deny state
governed identity assumed to own governing policy
policy change lacks traceable change evidence

prose.summary: Define AccessCore policy objects as explicit stable canonical identities with scope, resource targets and rule ownership separate from UI configuration and runtime decision state.
